It occurs three times in this file (bnRankGe_zero_iff_bnExists, bnRankGe_of_le, not_bnRankGe_of_lt). It also occurs in RankInvariance.lean (BNExists_mono_degree), ElementaryExistence.lean (BNExists_rank_zero) and ChipFiringWithLean/Rank.lean (private eff_of_degree_nonempty). I did not check the other rewrites against the compiler. The proposed lemma is a refactor of existing proofs, and its proof is the existing code, so it should compile. findings.excerpt:
let E : CFDiv G := r.toNat • oneChip v
    have hEffective : effective E := (Eff G).nsmul_mem (eff_one_chip v) r.toNat
findings.problem: Three proofs in this file each build, by hand, an effective divisor of a prescribed nonnegative degree m. They pick an arbitrary vertex v and set E := m.toNat • oneChip v. They prove effectiveness with nsmul_mem. They get the degree from AddMonoidHom.map_nsmul together with Int.toNat_of_nonneg and a simpa. The block is about six lines and appears at lines 117-123 (m = r), lines 198-205 (m = k - k') and lines 223-230 (m = r + k). The same block also appears in other files: BNExists_mono_degree in RankInvariance.lean, BNExists_rank_zero in ElementaryExistence.lean, and the private eff_of_degree_nonempty in ChipFiringWithLean/Rank.lean. The toNat/map_nsmul bookkeeping is the fiddly part, and it is restated each time. The only existing helper is private and returns Set.Nonempty of effOfDegree, so none of these proofs can use it.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one public lemma, preferably by exposing the Rank.lean one: `theorem exists_effective_of_degree (G : CFGraph) {m : ℤ} (hm : 0 ≤ m) : ∃ E : CFDiv G, effective E ∧ CFDiv.degree E = m`. Proof: take v := Classical.arbitrary G.V and E := m.toNat • oneChip v. Effectiveness is `(Eff G).nsmul_mem (eff_one_chip v) m.toNat`. The degree comes from the existing simpa [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hm] using AddMonoidHom.map_nsmul. Rewritten uses:
(1) In bnRankGe_zero_iff_bnExists, replace the let/have block with `obtain ⟨E, hEffective, hE⟩ := exists_effective_of_degree G hr; obtain ⟨D, hDegD, hRankD, _⟩ := h E hEffective (by rw [hE]; ring)`.
(2) In bnRankGe_of_le, use `obtain ⟨F, hFEffective, hFDegree⟩ := exists_effective_of_degree G hSlack`. The remaining proof is unchanged, since it only uses F through hFEffective and hFDegree.
(3) In not_bnRankGe_of_lt, use `obtain ⟨E, hEffective, hDegree⟩ := exists_effective_of_degree G (show 0 ≤ r + k by omega)`. The rest is unchanged.
BNExists_mono_degree and BNExists_rank_zero reduce the same way. If the lemma is stated as `(effOfDegree G m).Nonempty`, the Rank.lean lemma only needs to become non-private.
findings.benefit: The toNat/nsmul/degree bookkeeping is written and maintained once instead of five or six times. Each of the three proofs here loses about six lines of routine coercion work, so the mathematical steps (padding, absorbing, degree ceiling) are easier to see. A change to the definition of oneChip, effective or degree would need one fix instead of several.
